entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'm calling about an order. I'd like to return a VeloBand Pulse that I recently purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference thing. It works fine, but it's just not what I was hoping for in terms of the data it provides. I'm not really using it.
I see. Thank you for clarifying. I'll just need to pull up your order to check the return eligibility. When did you receive the VeloBand Pulse?
Let's see... it was a bit ago. It arrived on December 15th.
Okay, thank you. Let me check the system... I see the delivery date was 25 days ago. Unfortunately, I have to let you know that it's too late to process a return for this item.
Oh. I thought VeloFit had a 90-day return policy? I'm sure I saw that on the website for other gear.

You're right, we do have that policy for items like jerseys and shoes. However, the VeloBand Pulse has a different, specific policy due to its nature as a wearable electronic device. The return window is strictly 10 days from the date of delivery.

I see. Well, it's barely been used and it's in perfect condition. I understand I'm outside the 10-day window, but given it's only 25 days, could we perhaps arrange for store credit instead of a full refund?

I understand your position, but our policy on this is firm and I'm not able to make an exception. After the 10-day window, we can't accept the VeloBand Pulse back for hygiene and bio-contaminant reasons.
Hygiene? I've wiped it down completely. It's perfectly clean. How about a 50% credit? Or even just a discount code for my next purchase? I'm just trying to find a middle ground here.

I do appreciate you trying to work with me, but I'm not authorized to offer credits or discounts in this scenario. The strict return policy is in place for customer safety and sanitation standards. Once it has been in a customer's possession for that long, we simply cannot resell it.
So there's absolutely nothing you can do? It's just a complete loss for me?

I'm truly sorry that it's too late for a return. My recommendation, and what many other customers do, is list the item on the official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. Since it's in like-new condition, you can often recoup a good portion of the cost there. The policy is just something I cannot override.
Okay. The Resale Marketplace. I guess that's my only real option. Thank you for explaining the situation, Diana.
You're welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thanks.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
